_comment: Publisher destinations. Paste IDs from your Notion URLs. Leave a value null to skip that destination — the publisher writes to docs/ instead. Delete this file entirely to disable Notion and use the markdown fallback for everything.
_how_to_get_ids: Open the page or database in Notion, copy the URL. The ID is the 32-character hex string before any '?'. For https://notion.so/myspace/Docs-Board-abc123...def, the ID is abc123...def.
